title: Schauberger's propulsion work taken to Brookhaven

tellings.quote: Shaburgger I know the army counter intelligence corp tricked into giving all of his propulsion exotic propulsion stuff uh to the US and that made it actually to Brook Haven National Labs Nick Cook.com

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Viktor Schauberger, who worked on unusual ways of propelling craft, was tricked by the Army Counter Intelligence Corps, a US Army intelligence unit, into handing over his work. Michels says that work ended up at Brookhaven National Laboratory, a US government research lab, and points listeners to the writer Nick Cook for more, which if true would mean the US quietly took over this exotic research.
